args.description: hangs from his raised hands, both arms stretched straight up with the hands closed on nothing near the top of the picture, legs swaying gently below, a seamless loop; empty background above and around the hands: no log, no bar, no branch, no cliff, no rock, no wall, no platform. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no effect, no motion streak, no speed lines, no trail behind the limbs or the weapon, no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon clearly in a crisp pose, never blurred.
args.subject_description: a young man with messy white hair and blue eyes, a long white coat with grey tails, a black shirt, black trousers and grey boots
args.initial_pose: hanging from his raised hands, arms stretched straight up, legs dangling, empty background above the hands
